A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VMoER study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–H are readable and can be matched reliably, including content displaced by the new Appendix A.3.

before.justification: v1 reports original calibration, out-of-distribution detection, and routing-stability experiments on three MoE architectures, plus motivational experiments and layer-selection ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendices B, D, and F, including quantitative comparisons and ablations.

M1.justification: The VGLR-MF, VGLR-FC, and VTSR architectures, objectives, and inference procedures are unchanged, as are Algorithms 1–3 and Appendix C's implementation listings. Appendix A.3 analyzes the existing averaging-before-Top-K procedure without changing it.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ID performance on OBQA, ARC-Challenge, SciQ, and MedMCQA, and OBQA-based distribution shifts to ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MedMCQA, and MMLU-Law. The perturbation scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding experiments, including MAP, Temp-Scale, MCDropout/MCDR, and SWAG where evaluated. The added explanation of Temp-Scale's sampling behavior does not establish a changed comparator.

E3.justification: The model configurations, data splits, preprocessing, metrics, and perturbation protocols remain unchanged. Appendix D retains the three-epoch LoRA stage, ten-epoch variational stage, ten selected layers, and one training versus 35 evaluation Monte Carlo samples.

E4.justification: Appendix B's noise-sensitivity and stochastic-routing studies, Appendix D.4's stability tests, and Appendix F's layer-count and placement ablations retain the same questions and evidence. No empirical supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 1 still reports averages over five runs, and Table 7 still reports means and standard deviations over five runs. The figures' variability displays are unchanged; no new uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing procedure is reported.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical results and plotted findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Granite VGLR-FC retains ECE 0.015 in Table 1 and average inferred-logit-variance AUROC 0.749 in Table 2. Relocated displays contain the same results.

T1.justification: New Appendix A.3, Equations 26–29, distinguishes unbiased probability averaging from biased discrete selection after Top-K and contrasts this with averaging individual selection masks. This adds limited formal reasoning about the existing estimator; the original KL and entropy derivations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The two routing families and the central calibration, stability, distribution-shift detection, and efficiency claims are retained. The abstract's added fine-tuning wording makes the already documented experimental context explicit without redefining the contributions.

C2.justification: Section 3.3's new footnote and Appendix A.3 acknowledge selection bias and explain its tradeoff with preserving K-expert sparsity. Section 5.2 additionally attributes Temp-Scale's accuracy degradation to stochastic expert selection. Existing temperature-collapse, MCQA-only, and scaling limitations remain.

D1.justification: Section 5.2 now explicitly links the evaluated Temp-Scale baseline to sampling experts from temperature-scaled probabilities, clarifying its previously brief fixed-temperature description. This is added documentation; implementation listings, hyperparameters, hardware, and training-time disclosures are unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Mandt et al.'s variational tempering and connects it to VTSR, while expanding discussion of the already-cited Dialameh et al. as a complementary expert-weight approach. The Welbl reference changes from a word-sense dataset paper to multiple-choice science questions.

P1.justification: Changes are localized explanatory additions and revisions, including Appendix A.3 and expanded baseline and related-work passages. v3 also adds a conflict-of-interest disclosure, updates publication text, and fixes a typo and the broken Algorithm 2 reference. The overall organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Existing displays are reflowed and relocated: Table 1 moves from PDF page 6 to page 7, and Figure 6 and Table 2 change column placement. Figure contents, axes, legends, captions, and table structures remain unchanged; no figures or tables are added.

improvement.justification: Appendix A.3 and the new inference footnote make v1's unacknowledged selection bias explicit and explain the sparsity tradeoff, improving theoretical transparency. Clarifying Temp-Scale and its relationship to the reported accuracy changes also helps interpretation. These are useful, limited improvements; the methods and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
